newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toray to boost PPS production in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Toray to boost PPS production in Japan.

text.p: Toray Industries Inc said on Tuesday it plans to invest 1.5 billion yen to expand polyphenylene sulfide (PPS) production facilities at its Tokai plant in central Japan.
The company said it expects a new production line to start operating in October 1997 with an initial capacity of about 5,700 tonnes per year of the polymer base.
In 1995, the annual demand for PPS resins worldwide was 30,000 tonnes and 10,000 tonnes in Japan, a company statement said. The firm said it expects demand to grow at around 10 percent annually.
PPS is used in a wide rage of applications, including electric and electronics parts, car parts and heat-resistant fibres and films.
